templates.name: 单图人物PV·基础版
templates.description: 单图人物PV·基础版｜操作：①图1=人物参考（必选，脸/发型/服装全部保真，可作参考不锁首帧，也可强制首帧）；②选视觉设定/时长（推荐10-15秒）；③文字默认无字，要文字就在模板文字框写（自动放顶部/片尾，不挡脸）；④生成提示词→生成PV。建议先低分辨率0.2测试，OK后再提高。
templates.description_en: Single-image character PV, basic version | How to use: (1) Img1 = the character reference (required; face, hair and outfit preserved, usable as a reference without locking the first frame, or forced as the first frame); (2) choose the visual setting and duration (10-15 seconds recommended); (3) no text by default - to add text, type it in the template's text box (placed at the top or on the end card so it never covers the face); (4) generate the prompt, then generate the PV. Test at low resolution (0.2) first, then raise it.
templates.generation_mode: Multimodal Fusion (多模态融合 Ref2VA)【多图参考+自定义场景】
templates.prompt:
[REFERENCE IMAGES ARE THE SOLE TRUTH / 参考图是唯一真相 — ABSOLUTE MANDATE]: The model MUST copy the reference images directly. Do NOT invent, improvise, guess, hallucinate, or 'improve' any face, hairstyle, outfit, color, pattern, fabric, body type, accessory, or prop that is not explicitly shown in the connected <Picture N> reference images. If the prompt text and a reference image disagree, the reference image WINS. The output character's face MUST look like the person in <Picture 1>@图1 — same eyes, nose, mouth, skin tone, eyebrow shape, hairline, hair color, hair texture, and facial proportions. The output outfit MUST look like the clothing in the outfit reference picture — same garment type, same sleeves, same hem length, same color, same pattern, same texture, same buttons/zippers/pockets, same collar, same waistline, same accessories. If the reference image shows a specific outfit, the video shows THAT exact outfit — not a different color, not a different pattern, not a different cut. If the reference image shows a specific hairstyle, the video shows THAT exact hairstyle — not a different length, not a different color, not a different style. 【参考图是唯一真相·绝对强制】模型必须直接复制参考图，严禁凭空想象、自行设计、猜测或美化任何未在<Picture N>参考图中明确展示的面部/发型/服装/颜色/花纹/面料/体型/配饰/道具。提示词文字与参考图冲突时，一律以参考图为准。输出人物的脸必须长得和<Picture 1>@图1里的人一模一样——同样的眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、肤色、眉形、发际线、发色、发质、面部比例。输出服装必须和服装参考图里的衣服一模一样——同样的版型、袖长、裙摆、颜色、花纹、面料、纽扣/拉链/口袋、领口、腰线、配饰。参考图是什么服装，视频就必须是什么服装——严禁更改颜色、花纹或款式。参考图是黑色长发，视频就必须是黑色长发——不是短发、不是棕发、不是马尾。

[STRICT MULTI-REFERENCE COMPLIANCE / 严格多参考声明]: EVERY <Picture N> referenced in this prompt is an independent reference and MUST be strictly followed — face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, accessories and weapon/prop must be preserved EXACTLY per its OWN <Picture N>. NEVER follow only one reference image while ignoring the others: every referenced <Picture N> must take effect. 本提示词中出现的每一个 <Picture N> 都是独立的参考图，必须逐一严格遵循其各自的面部、发型、服装、体型、配饰与道具，严禁只参考其中一张而忽略其他任何一张；所有被引用的参考图都必须完整生效。

[TEXT OVERLAY CONTROL / PV文字叠层控制 — 导演级自由]: This is a PV (promotional video), so text on screen is a DIRECTED element, NOT a default. Follow these rules in order of priority: (1) If the user wants NO text, render the entire video with ZERO characters, logos, subtitles, captions, or burned-in text — a pure visual cut. (2) If custom text is given, place it EXACTLY where stated (top / center / bottom / end card), in the stated language and style, with clean typography, and keep the text fully readable and stable for the duration it appears. (3) Text must NEVER cover the hero subject's face or the product's key details; it sits in reserved areas (top third, bottom third, or a dedicated end card). (4) On-screen text must be spelled EXACTLY as written — no extra letters, no omissions, no transliteration changes. 【PV文字叠层控制·导演级自由】这是宣传片(PV)，画面文字是导演指令元素而非默认项，按优先级执行：① 不要文字时，全片零字符、零水印、零字幕——纯画面剪辑；② 给了自定义文字时，必须按指定位置（顶部/居中/底部/片尾卡）、指定语言与字体风格呈现，字迹清晰、稳定不飘；③ 文字严禁遮挡主体人物的脸或产品关键细节，只能放在预留区（画面上三分之一、下三分之一或独立片尾卡）；④ 屏幕文字必须与所写逐字一致——不多字、不少字、不转写变形。

subject_definitions:
  <Subject 1> is the person from <Picture 1>@图1 — face, hair, body, outfit and styling come EXACTLY from <Picture 1>@图1.
summary:
  Create a 12-second character promotional video (PV) starring <Subject 1>. Fast, punchy rhythm with 4 quick cuts. The video showcases the character's presence and attitude. Reference image is a style/identity reference, NOT a locked first frame — composition and motion are free, only identity stays locked.
retention_analysis:
  <Subject 1> (All shots): fully_preserved — face, hair, body, outfit identical to <Picture 1>@图1, no matter the new pose, angle, or motion.
  Composition & background: free_creation — a new stylish environment of the user's choosing.
detailed_description:
  [Shot 1] At 00:00.000, a wide establishing shot. <Subject 1> stands centered, strong pose, camera slowly pushes in. Dynamic rim lighting, shallow depth of field.
  [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, cut to a medium shot from a low angle. <Subject 1> walks toward camera with confident stride. Slight camera tilt for energy.
  [Shot 3] At 00:06.500, cut to a close-up: <Subject 1> looks into the lens, subtle expression shift. Cinematic bokeh background.
  [Shot 4] At 00:09.500, cut to a full-body hero pose. Freeze-frame energy, then a slow pull-back. Final frame holds on <Subject 1> centered.
overall_soundscape: Sharp clothing movement, footsteps on polished floor, airy room tone.
non_diegetic_music: Modern pop-hybrid PV track — driving four-on-the-floor beat, bright synth stabs, confident and energetic.
templates.text_fallback_mode: Text to Video (文生视频)【默认人物+默认场景】
templates.text_fallback_prompt:
[STRICT REFERENCE / 参考图强制] 未连接任何参考图，本模板启用内置默认配置并转为文生视频模式。所有内容由文字描述决定，禁止虚构文字与描述冲突的细节。

[DEFAULT CONFIG / 默认配置]: DEFAULT CHARACTER: a stylish young woman, delicate facial features, long black hair, well-proportioned figure, wearing an elegant black high-fashion outfit. DEFAULT SCENE: a dark studio with dramatic spotlight and cinematic haze. DEFAULT TEXT: none (pure visual cut).

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1][0-3s] Wide establishing shot, the character stands centered under a spotlight, camera slowly pushes in, strong pose. [Shot 2][3-6s] Medium low-angle shot, she walks toward camera with confident stride, slight camera tilt. [Shot 3][6-9s] Close-up, she looks into the lens, subtle expression shift, cinematic bokeh. [Shot 4][9-12s] Full-body hero pose, slow pull-back, final frame holds on her centered. Text: none. Fast PV rhythm, sharp cuts, premium fashion grade.

overall_soundscape: Sharp clothing movement, footsteps on polished floor, airy room tone.
non_diegetic_music: Modern pop-hybrid PV track — driving four-on-the-floor beat, bright synth stabs, confident and energetic.

templates.description: 纯文字PV·无图生成｜操作：①不传图，在文字框写清主角（长相/服装/年龄）、场景、动作、镜头、要不要文字/写什么字；②选文生视频模式；③生成提示词→生成PV。描述越具体画面越可控。
templates.description_en: Text-only PV, no image needed | How to use: (1) upload nothing; in the text box describe the lead (looks, outfit, age), the scene, the action, the camera and whether you want text and what it should say; (2) choose text-to-video mode; (3) generate the prompt, then generate the PV. The more specific the description, the more controllable the result.

summary:
  Create a 10-second text-driven PV with NO input image. Everything — hero, setting, wardrobe, motion, camera, and on-screen text — is generated purely from this written description. Use the user's description as the sole creative brief; if the user described a specific hero (name, look, outfit), preserve it consistently across all shots.
detailed_description:
  [Shot 1] At 00:00.000, an establishing shot matching the user's described scene. Dynamic lighting, strong composition, cinematic color grade.
  [Shot 2] At 00:02.500, cut to the hero in action as described — motion, gesture, or interaction with the environment. Medium shot, fluid camera move.
  [Shot 3] At 00:05.500, cut to a close-up detail — face, hands, or object per the user's description. Shallow depth of field, premium look.
  [Shot 4] At 00:08.000, cut to a final hero shot that resolves the story beat, ending on a clean, memorable frame (optionally with the end-card text overlay per TEXT OVERLAY CONTROL).
overall_soundscape: Ambient atmosphere matching the scene; subtle motion whoosh on cuts.
non_diegetic_music: Punchy, modern PV soundtrack with a clear beat drop timed to the strongest cut.

templates.description: 单图产品PV·宣传展示｜操作：①图1=产品图（必选，形状/颜色/logo/标签文字全部保真）；②默认产品为绝对主体，4镜头（揭幕→特写→场景→品牌收尾）；③品牌名/卖点写进文字框，自动做片尾卡；④先低分辨率0.2测试再提高。
templates.description_en: Single-image product PV, promo showcase | How to use: (1) Img1 = the product image (required; shape, colour, logo and label text all preserved); (2) the product is the absolute subject by default, in four shots (reveal, close-up, scene, brand end card); (3) put the brand name and selling points in the text box and an end card is built automatically; (4) test at low resolution (0.2) first, then raise it.

subject_definitions:
  <Subject 1> is the product from <Picture 1>@图1 — its EXACT shape, color, material, logo, labels, packaging and every visible detail must be preserved in every shot.
summary:
  Create a 10-second product promotional video (PV). <Picture 1>@图1 is the hero product; the video is a premium product showcase — hero reveal, detail macro, lifestyle cut, and a final brand-hold frame. The product IS the star; any background, props, or surfaces are supporting elements only.
retention_analysis:
  <Subject 1> (All shots): fully_preserved — identical shape, color, finish, logo, and label text at all times; NO redesign, NO logo distortion, NO label swapping.
  Background & props: free_creation — premium minimal sets that flatter the product.
detailed_description:
  [Shot 1] At 00:00.000, a hero reveal: the product emerges from darkness into a spotlight beam, slowly rotating. Clean premium background.
  [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, cut to a macro detail shot — surface texture, logo engraving, or label. Extreme close-up, shallow depth of field.
  [Shot 3] At 00:05.500, cut to a lifestyle shot — the product in an elegant context (table, light, motion). Gentle camera orbit or dolly.
  [Shot 4] At 00:08.000, cut back to a hero product shot on a pedestal, slow push-in, ending on a clean brand-hold frame (end-card text per TEXT OVERLAY CONTROL).
overall_soundscape: Soft whoosh on transitions, subtle glass/metal foley for product moves, gentle room tone.
non_diegetic_music: Sleek minimal electronic track — crisp percussion, warm pads, premium and understated.

[DEFAULT CONFIG / 默认配置]: DEFAULT PRODUCT: an elegant premium perfume bottle with golden liquid, crystal-cut cap and gold ring, minimal label. DEFAULT SCENE: black studio with a single spotlight. DEFAULT TEXT: end-card brand name only if the user provides one; otherwise no text.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1][0-2.5s] Hero reveal: the product emerges from darkness into a spotlight beam, slowly rotating. [Shot 2][2.5-5s] Macro detail shot of surface texture and cap, extreme close-up, shallow depth of field. [Shot 3][5-7.5s] Lifestyle shot: the product on an elegant reflective surface, gentle camera orbit. [Shot 4][7.5-10s] Product hero shot on a pedestal, slow push-in, ending on a clean brand-hold frame. Text: none unless user provides brand text (then show it on the final end card only).

overall_soundscape: Soft whooshes on transitions, subtle glass foley, gentle room tone.
non_diegetic_music: Sleek minimal electronic track — crisp percussion, warm pads, premium and understated.

templates.name: 人物+产品广告PV·双参考
templates.description: 人物+产品广告PV·双参考｜操作：①图1=模特/人物，图2=产品（香水/美妆/数码等）；②默认『模特+产品互动』；想以产品为主或以模特为主，在文字框写明优先级；③产品瓶身/标签原有文字强制保留；④片尾可加品牌文字；⑤先0.2测试，OK再提清。
templates.description_en: Character plus product ad PV, two references | How to use: (1) Img1 = the model or character, Img2 = the product (perfume, cosmetics, gadgets and so on); (2) the default is the model interacting with the product; if you want the product or the model to dominate, state the priority in the text box; (3) any text already on the bottle or label is forcibly preserved; (4) brand text can be added at the end; (5) test at 0.2 first, then raise the resolution.
